settings.credential: Street musician, Linz · busks across Europe
settings.relation: Marcel started playing handpan in 2013, with a caisa drum. Later he got a steelharp, which led him to his Ayasa, the first instrument he was proud of. He is a street musician based out of Linz, Austria, travelling and busking as he goes – he’s always up for a jam.
settings.quote: When Ralf told me I could come and get an Ayasa I had no money, it was at the beginning of 2015. So I worked incredibly hard during the winter months, busking until my fingers bled. I made it to the Netherlands and was so grateful to pick up my first beauty, the Ayasa ayaziska aka the Ferrari. It’s still my main instrument. Thank you Ayasa!
